@NullMarked public interface HumanEntity extends LivingEntity, AnimalTamer, InventoryHolder
代表人类实体, 比如一个NPC或一名玩家

原文： Represents a human entity, such as an NPC or a player

      @Deprecated(forRemoval=true, since="1.21") boolean setWindowProperty(InventoryView.Property prop, int value)
      已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
      请使用 InventoryView 及其子类

      原文：use InventoryView and its children.

      若玩家当前打开了一个物品栏窗口, 此方法将设置窗口的属性, 比如酿造台的酿造进度.

      原文： If the player currently has an inventory window open, this method will set a property of that window, such as the state of a progress bar.

      参数:
      prop - 窗口属性

      原文：The property.

      value - 要设置的属性值

      原文：The value to set the property to.

      返回:
      若属性成功设置返回true

      原文：True if the property was successfully set.

    • getOpenInventory

      InventoryView getOpenInventory()
      获取玩家正在查看的物品栏. 如果他们没有打开任何物品栏窗口, 将返回他们的内部合成视图(玩家背包的那四个格子?).

    • setCooldown

      default void setCooldown(Material material, int ticks)
      设置指定物品的冷却时长. 设为0 tick将导致移除此物品的冷却.

      冷却被服务器用来针对某些物品比如末影珍珠、盾牌等以防止它们被经常重复使用.

      请注意: 冷却时间自身不会阻止某个物品被用来使用或攻击.

      原文： Set a cooldown on the specified material for a certain amount of ticks. 0 ticks will result in the removal of the cooldown.

      Cooldowns are used by the server for items such as ender pearls and shields to prevent them from being used repeatedly.

      Note that cooldowns will not by themselves stop an item from being used for attacking.

      参数:
      material - 为哪个物品设置冷却

      原文：the material to set the cooldown for

      ticks - 冷却时长(以tick为单位)或设为0来移除它

      原文：the amount of ticks to set or 0 to remove

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果 material 不是物品

      原文：if the material is not an item

    • undiscoverRecipes

      int undiscoverRecipes(java.util.Collection<NamespacedKey> recipes)
      取消玩家对一组已发现配方的发现状态。此方法将从玩家的配方书中移除这些配方。如果集合中某个配方尚未被发现，它将被静默忽略。

      原文： Undiscover a collection of recipes for this player such that they have already been discovered. This method will remove the keys' associated recipes from the player's recipe book. If a recipe in the provided collection has not yet been discovered, it will be silently ignored.

      参数:
      recipes - 要取消发现的配方的key集合

      原文：the keys of the recipes to undiscover

      返回:
      被取消发现的配方数量，0表示没有被取消发现的配方，等于 recipes.size() 的数字表示所有配方都被取消发现

      原文：the amount of undiscovered recipes where 0 indicates that none were undiscovered and a number equal to recipes.size() indicates that all were undiscovered

      @Nullable Item dropItem(int slot, int amount, boolean throwRandomly, @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<Item> entityOperation)
      Makes the player drop an item from their inventory based on the inventory slot.
      参数:
      slot - the slot to drop
      amount - the number of items to drop from this slot. Values below one always return null
      throwRandomly - controls the randomness of the dropped items velocity, where true mimics dropped items during a player's death, while false acts like a normal item drop.

      抛出:

    • getExhaustion

      float getExhaustion()
      获取玩家的疲劳度.

      疲劳度控制者玩家的饥饿消耗. 当玩家达到一定的疲劳度时, 你的饱食度就会下降, 并且疲劳度归零.

      译注:如果饱食度为0, 那么就扣饥饿度.

      译注2:运动会产生疲劳度.

      原文： Gets the players current exhaustion level.

      Exhaustion controls how fast the food level drops. While you have a certain amount of exhaustion, your saturation will drop to zero, and then your food will drop to zero.

      返回:
      疲劳度

      原文：Exhaustion level

    • setExhaustion

      设置玩家的疲劳度.

      原文： Sets the players current exhaustion level

      参数:
      value - 疲劳度

      原文：Exhaustion level

    • getSaturation

      float getSaturation()
      获取玩家的饱食度(不是饥饿度).

      饱食度是一个饥饿度的缓存. 当你的饱食度 > 0的时候,饥饿度是不会下降的.

      译注:就是说, 吃东西的时候, 你的饥饿度被填满了, 而多出来的部分就是隐藏的饱食度. 当你的疲劳值(见getExhaustion()) 达到一定程度时, 如果饱食度不为0, 那么先扣饱食度. 只有当没饱食度时, 才会扣饥饿度. 其实饱食度就是饥饿度, 只不过是隐藏的.

      原文： Gets the players current saturation level.

      Saturation is a buffer for food level. Your food level will not drop if you are saturated > 0.

      返回:
      饱食度

      原文：Saturation level

    • fireworkBoost

      @Nullable Firework fireworkBoost(ItemStack fireworkItemStack)
      执行烟花火箭加速。

      原文： Perform a firework boost.

      This method will only work such that LivingEntity.isGliding() is true and the entity is actively gliding with an elytra. Additionally, the supplied fireworkItemStack must be a firework rocket. The power of the boost will directly correlate to FireworkMeta.getPower().

      参数:
      fireworkItemStack - 用于滑翔的烟花火箭物品堆

      原文：the firework item stack to use to glide

      返回:
      附加的 Firework，如果实体无法被加速则返回null

      原文：the attached Firework, or null if the entity could not be boosted

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果fireworkItemStack不是烟花火箭

      原文：if the fireworkItemStack is not a firework
